Read the supplied route data and rules and draft the final plan as a JSON array of step tokens drawn ONLY from this fixed vocabulary: "depart_base", "return_base", "refuel", "uplink", and for each mast M in {Brill Spur, Kessog Notch, Vantwill Flat, Dunmore Cap}: "visit:M" and "calibrate:M". Return raw JSON only, no markdown fences, no prose.

The artifact itself, in its exact specified format, begins on line 2.

Route data:

Fixed one-way route distances from Base:
Brill Spur = 35 km
Kessog Notch = 52 km
Vantwill Flat = 60 km
Dunmore Cap = 140 km
Vehicle fuel range without refueling = 100 km.
Vantwill Flat is the only fuel depot.
Dunmore Cap (140 km) exceeds fuel range and is unreachable without refueling first at Vantwill Flat.
Washed-out track: driving Brill Spur -> Kessog Notch back-to-back is forbidden.
Every mast must be calibrated immediately upon arrival.
Survey data can only be uplinked once all four masts are calibrated.

Draft the plan as a JSON array.
